description: Append-only compact index of continuous workflow simulation session records. Raw compact evidence remains immutable; post-hoc integrity assessments may exclude records from objective use without rewriting raw metrics or artifacts.
append_policy: Add one immutable workflow_session record per executed baseline or treatment session. Never reuse a session ID or overwrite its compact evidence. A reusable baseline-pool identity is the frozen protocol fingerprint plus replicate, not execution date; the fingerprint binds fixture snapshot, task/verifier bytes, baseline substrate, runtime/model condition, and isolation policy. Completed workflow-simulation reproduction records must use sequential one-task-at-a-time prompt delivery, lazy future-prompt materialization, controller-only verifier assets, verifier integrity hashes, and seed-origin concealment. Create comparisons only after reviewed baseline and treatment records for the same pool exist. Supersede rather than delete historical results. A post-hoc integrity assessment may change status or objective eligibility only when the raw metrics/artifacts are preserved and the reason/evidence are recorded.
